description: Get structured Amazon product data by ASIN — title, price, rating, reviews count, features, images, availability. Example: scraperapi_amazon_product({ asin: "B0BFC7WQ6R", country: "us", tld: "com", _apiKey: "your-key" })

country.description: Two-letter country code for proxy geotargeting, e.g. "us", "gb". Optional.

tld.description: Amazon marketplace top-level domain, e.g. "com", "co.uk", "de". Optional (default com).

name: scraperapi_amazon_product
title: Scraperapi Amazon Product
